title: Agent report result
description: What an agent hands back after a job: which context pack it ran on, what it cites, what it could not establish and which memory it wants updated. status deferred means a required pre-gate was missing and no work was done; ok requires at least one cite. homelabnext.agent.validate_report adds the cross-checks JSON Schema cannot (pack_id equals the pack hash, every must-cite source is cited, cites reference sources present in the pack). 1.1 adds the optional output: the job's structured result, which an actor receiving the report through a handoff (agent/handoff) accepts only after it validates against that handoff's declared output_schema. 1.2 adds, additively, sources on a memory update (ADR-0037 decision 7): at most 16 unique identifiers, each a content digest (sha256:<hex>), a canonical record uid (a UUIDv7, never a legacy record code) or a memory revision (mem:<profile id>/<scope>/<key>@<rev>); the platform applies an update only when every source equals an identifier the pack assembler recorded for something the pack rendered (homelabnext.agent.report.source_problems). 1.2 also adds verify to op (decision 15): a verify reasserts a live entry, takes no value, and must cite at least one source the pack rendered that is not a mem: revision (homelabnext.agent.report.verify_problems); it sets the entry's reasserted_at, and only a platform Verifier sets verified_at. The limits of 64 memory_updates and 128 cites are enforced in code (validate_report, MemoryStore), not here, since tightening an existing list is not additive.

sources.description: What the update rests on (ADR-0037 decision 7): identifiers the pack assembler wrote for what the pack rendered, never text. Absent or empty: the entry is stored unsourced.

output.description: Structured result for an actor (G-04): validated against the handoff's output_schema before an actor reads any of it; summary and unknowns are free text and never reach an action.
